messages:
elaine: Heads-up: product wants to move routing off the `X-Routing-Meta` header and into a structured request body field `routing.policy` (v3). Target window ~8 weeks. Need cross-team plan (SDKs, console, quotas, telemetry).
robert: Big ask for billing: quotas are keyed by header values today. We must alias keys or we'll break billing continuity. Propose read-paths accept both formats for a limited window.
mina: SDK approach: implement an adapter that serializes legacy header -> new body field. Expose config `compatMode: 'header-v1' | 'auto' | 'off'` in TS/py. Default `auto` for two releases then `off`. Emit single startup deprecation log.
devex-bot: Deploy queued: feature/structured-routing-v3 -> canary 2024-06-10 04:00 UTC :calendar:
elaine: Telemetry: add tag `routing.format` values: `header_v1`,`body_v3`,`none`. Also emit `routing.policy.hash` to track mapping stability over time.
robert: Console UX: add a migration preview where admins can map header values -> structured rules and run a simulation. Also add a per-tenant "simulate only" toggle.
mina: Python plan: release 2.3.0 adapter (default auto) that logs DeprecationWarning on import. 2.4.0 flips default to `off`. Provide `REDWOOD_ROUTING_COMPAT=header` env var for emergency opt-in.
robert: Go note: can't runtime-emit DeprecationWarning nicely. Add prometheus gauge `redwood_routing_compat{mode="header"}` + `/debug/compat` for ops to scrape.
ops-bot: Migration job scheduled: route-format-backfill -> run 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC (scan last 30 days) :gear:
elaine: Quota migration proposal: alias writes to both old and new quota keys for 30 days, then run a reconcile job to merge counters and flip writes to new keys only. Need billing owner.
mina: TS snippet for client opt-in:
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ routing: { compatMode: 'auto' } });
```
client will auto-copy header into the body field during the adapter window.
robert: Risk: some proxies strip request bodies or normalize headers. Detection heuristic: if SDK version >= adapter_release and `routing.format == "header_v1"`, mark tenant `suspected_proxy_rewrite`. Add column in support CSV.
elaine: Console telemetry dashboard: top 15 tenants by legacy usage, WoW delta, and a list of suspected proxy rewrites. Ops wants an alert when legacy usage is >80% after week 4.
mina: Devex asks: add `--simulate-body` CLI flag in SDKs so SEs can locally exercise the new payload, and unit tests asserting `routing.format` tag set correctly for each mode.
robert: Docs: include Envoy filter example for teams that want to rewrite header->body at the edge and a rollback snippet for proxies. Also include billing mapping examples.
devex-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/structured-routing-1778889999 :white_check_mark:
elaine: Timeline draft: Week0 announce & docs; Week1 telemetry + console preview + backfill job; Week2-5 SDK adapters (py/ts/go) ship; Week6 flip TS/Py defaults off; Week9 server stops accepting header with 2-week rollback. Pilot cohort: 5 tenants first.
mina: I'll own the Python adapter release. robert: I'll own quota aliasing + reconcile job. elaine: console UX + comms. Any blockers?
robert: Billing wants 2 owners for the reconcile job. Assigning Carlos + Priya.
elaine: Great. Adding owners to checklist and scheduling pilot. Thanks all :thumbsup:
